title: Pickleball Grandma Shirt, Sweet as Pie Sneaky at the Net, Funny Gift for Grandma, Nana or Mimi
description:
Sweet as pie off the court and sneaky at the net. A warm, funny shirt for the grandma everyone is scared to play against.

Who it's for:
- Grandmas who play pickleball several times a week
- Grandkids and adult children looking for a gift she will actually wear
- Mother's Day, birthday and Christmas shopping

About the design:
Arched 'PICKLEBALL' over a big 'GRANDMA', with two paddles and a ball below. Ask us for a Nana, Mimi, Gigi or Grammy version.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Pickleball Grandma design with two paddles and the line Sweet as pie, sneaky at the net on a light pink tee.
